app.title: TheoremFeed
home.title: Your study feed
home.empty.title: Upload your material
home.empty.body: Your feed only shows videos for concepts in your study material. Add a text-based PDF of your notes or textbook to get started.
gap.title: No videos yet: {concept}
gap.body: You're studying this concept but have no videos for it yet.
shorts.empty.title: No theorem shorts yet
shorts.empty.body: Theorem shorts are found on this device: the app searches YouTube for each curated theorem and keeps only English, educational, safe clips. The first run downloads the on-device AI model (about {size} MB, Wi-Fi recommended).
concept.out_of_scope: Not in your material or the theorem pool, so videos for it aren't collected.
home.filling: Finding videos for your notes. They appear here as they're added.
home.no_videos_yet: No videos here yet. Tap Find more videos, or check back while videos are added.
upload.stopped: Reading stopped. Nothing was saved; Continue reads the PDF again.
ingest.stopped: Stopped: {checked} checked · {accepted} added. Continue picks up where it stopped.
ingest.stopped_saved: Finding videos was stopped. Continue picks up where it stopped.
settings.title: Settings
settings.pool.title: Theorem pool
settings.pool.body: {shorts} shorts for {theorems} curated theorems. The Shorts tab fills a few theorems at a time as you scroll; this builds the whole pool in one go. Safe to re-run; it continues where it left off.
settings.privacy.title: What leaves this phone
settings.privacy.body: YouTube: searches for your concepts and theorem names, and video streams. Hugging Face: the one-time AI model download. Nothing else: the AI runs on this device, and there are no accounts or analytics.
settings.model.title: On-device AI model
settings.model.body: {name}, about {size} MB, downloaded once over the internet and then used offline. It checks videos (and, later, reads your PDFs) entirely on this device: free, no account, no limits.
settings.model.missing: Not downloaded yet. It downloads automatically the first time it's needed; Wi-Fi recommended.
material.title: My Material
material.summary_exam: {materials} materials · {concepts} concepts · {days} days to nearest exam
material.empty: No material yet. Upload a text-based PDF of your notes, a chapter or a textbook. The app reads it on this device, finds the concepts, and fills your feed with videos for them.
material.delete_confirm: Delete "{title}"? Its concepts leave your feeds and search. (It's kept on the device as deleted; uploading the same file again restores it.)
upload.done: Added "{title}": {concepts} concepts. Finding videos for them now.
upload.done_none: Added "{title}", but no concepts were found in it.
upload.reactivated: "{title}" was uploaded before; it's active again.
upload.rules_only: The AI model wasn't available, so only labelled theorems and definitions were read. Re-upload later for a full read.
golden.title: Example for the relevance check
golden.hint: Long-press a video to mark it as a good or bad example for the relevance check.
eval.title: Relevance check
eval.body: Measures how well your feed's top 10 videos match your judgement. On a concept's page, long-press videos to mark good and bad examples. The spec's set is {concepts} concepts with {videos} videos each (half good, half bad).
eval.none: Mark at least one good and one bad video for a concept first.
search.hint: Search your concepts, theorems or formulas
search.empty: Search what you're studying: concept names (typos are fine), formulas like ∫ u dv, or questions in plain English. Results come only from your material and the theorem pool.
search.material_inactive: No active material, so search covers the theorem pool only. Upload a PDF to search your own concepts.
player.offline: You're offline. Videos need a connection; your feeds, search and material still work.
settings.storage.title: Storage
settings.storage.body: Cached video links and thumbnails are rebuilt automatically. Clearing them never touches your material, concepts, saved videos or watch history.
you.history_empty: Videos you watch show up here.
you.saved_empty: Save videos from a short or a video's ⋮ menu.
settings.deep_read.title: Deep read with AI (slower)
settings.deep_read.body: Besides checking the concepts it finds, the AI also reads every section of your PDF. Finds a few more unlabelled concepts but takes minutes per chapter.
